The '''Janilis system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Cronese Mandate/Legends|Cronese Mandate]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Janilis VII]].

[[Sleeper ship/Legends|Sleeper ships]] colonized the system sometime after [[27,500 BBY]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
